en: Vintage black‑and‑white streetscape showing a gently sloping urban street lined with multi‑story stone or stucco townhouses on both sides. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn vehicle are visible in the distance. At the far end of the street a tall factory chimney rises above lower buildings and trees. The top of the card bears printed red text in German, and there is a shop sign on the right side of the street.
